items.name: Modothurian Hat
items.description: Prevents the wearer from getting wet, whether from rain or submersion.

items.name: Blue Flame Lantern
items.description: A lantern whose blue flame turns red when a fiend is within 60 feet.

items.name: Rope of Three Strands
items.description: A rope braided from three strands. When the wearer drops to 0 hit points, they drop to 1 hit point instead and a strand breaks.

charges.recovery: No recovery — each use permanently breaks a strand; usable at most once per day while a strand remains

items.name: Clockwork Amulet
items.description: An amulet shaped like interlocking gears. Once per day, instead of rolling a d20 for an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check, the wearer can decide they rolled a 10.

actions.name: Forced Result
actions.description: Replaces the result of a d20 roll (attack, saving throw, or ability check) with a flat 10.

items.name: Wooden Pipe
properties: Advantage on Performance checks made with a musical instrument
items.description: Whoever plays it sounds like a virtuoso. Once per day, they can cast Prestidigitation in the form of music.

actions.name: Musical Prestidigitation
actions.description: Casts the Prestidigitation spell by playing the pipe, without components.

items.name: Returning Throwing Axe
properties: Returns to the thrower's hand immediately after the attack
items.description: An enchanted throwing axe that instantly returns to its owner's hand after being thrown.

items.name: Boots of Elvenkind
items.description: While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound, regardless of the surface you are moving across. You also have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks that rely on moving silently.

items.name: Scale of Karapth
items.description: A dragon scale, warm to the touch. As a reaction, when the wearer takes fire damage, they gain resistance to that damage.

actions.name: Fire Ward
actions.description: Triggered as a reaction when the wearer takes fire damage: gains resistance to that damage.

items.name: Mother-Bramble Shard
items.description: A green crystal that grows slowly, like a plant. Once per day, the holder can cast Speak with Animals or Entangle (DC 12).

actions.name: Shard Spell
actions.description: Casts Speak with Animals or Entangle (save DC 12), the holder's choice.

items.name: Talking Mirror
items.description: An enchanted mirror that compliments whoever looks into it, sees through illusions and disguises, and reveals the true face of anyone who looks into it.
